job.text: Which region had the highest overall expenses, and which departments were the big spenders within each region?

insight.important: East spent the most, and Operations and HR were the big spenders in every region

title.text: East Spent the Most; Operations and HR Everywhere the Most

source.shows: several totals compared, and roughly which parts dominate each: multiple stacked bars (R7-20, G1.41), the regions by their totals, largest first, each total labelled at its stack's end, the departments in one order and colour in every stack (R7-24, G7.31, D-26 (b)), named beside the last stack, packed (D-31 (c); the book's legend at the right is the variant)

reasons.chart.labelling: the book's legend at the right (s. 0247)

source.shows: the book's legend column at the right, its entries top to bottom as the parts are stacked (D-31 (a), G5.8)

job.text: What share of each region's expenses went to each department?

insight.important: Operations took over a quarter of the expenses in every region

title.text: Operations Took Over a Quarter of Expenses Everywhere
